reflections.summary: The game was won because Annihilape’s bulk, Leftovers recovery, and snowballing Rage Fist allowed it to outlast the opponent’s fast offensive core after an early Taunt denied our Tailwind. Talonflame and Garchomp successfully absorbed key turns and removed redirection, giving Annihilape the windows to KO Kingambit and Sneasler.
reflections.adjustment: In team preview, Mega Floette was a poor fit against this opponent’s brought four—Gengar, Sneasler, and Kingambit all resist or threaten it—and its Fairy Aura benefited no ally. For the next game, replace Floette with a better answer to fast Poison-types (such as a Steel- or Ground-type) or an alternative speed control option that doesn’t rely on Talonflame alone. If Floette must stay, prioritize eliminating Mega Gengar before it can use Taunt.
reflections.notebook: Annihilape’s Rage Fist scales with hits taken (current base power 100 after 1 hit). Opponent aggressively uses Rage Powder with Sinistcha. Kingambit carries Shuca Berry to survive Ground moves, has Supreme Overlord, and runs Sucker Punch, Kowtow Cleave, Iron Head, Protect. Mega Gengar has Taunt alongside expected offensive moves; it was used to shut down Tailwind. Sneasler is Choice Scarf Jolly (Dire Claw, Close Combat, Rock Slide, U-turn). Talonflame’s Focus Sash is consumed. Opponent’s back-line Dragonite and Staraptor remain unrevealed; expect potential Tailwind or Intimidate in game 2. Annihilape’s Defiant punishes Intimidate, so Staraptor is often a liability for them. Shuca Berry means Kingambit can survive an Earthquake from full health—chip it first.

reflections.summary: Lost preview: Sinistcha+Gengar-Mega into Annihilape/Talonflame/Garchomp/Floette-Mega gave opponent free win. Sinistcha Rage Powder draws super-effective Rage Fist and dies, Gengar-Mega offers no pressure vs BulkUp Annihilape, and Scarf Sneasler locked into Dire Claw is hard-walled by Lum Garchomp (cures psn) + Talonflame Protect stall + Annihilape resist, letting Annihilape stack Rage Fist and CC Kingambit for sweep. Shuca Kingambit was planned for Garchomp EQ but died to Annihilape CC instead.
reflections.adjustment: Next game don't bring Sinistcha vs Annihilape core. Lead Gengar-Mega + Kingambit: Taunt Annihilape to deny BulkUp/Protect scaling, keep Kingambit Sucker Punch for Annihilape not Garchomp, and don't early-lock Sneasler into Dire Claw - use U-turn/Rock Slide or keep switch option to avoid Protect/Lum exploit.
